title: Daughter of Smoke and Bone
author: Laini Taylor
current_text: In October 2022, a parent of a Western Middle School student challenged Daughter of Smoke and Bone in the school library over depictions of characters smoking and discussing sex; that November, a district review committee relocated the novel and the rest of the trilogy to the high school library.

sources.quote: In October 2022, the parent of a Western Middle School student challenged Daughter of Smoke and Bone by Liani Taylor, from the school library. This title had not circulated in 10 years, but the parent took issue with its depictions of characters smoking and discussing sex. That November, a district review committee relocated the novel (and the rest of the Daughter of Smoke and Bone trilogy) to the high school library.
